reward_detail: Rewards change by round, so treat any number you read elsewhere with suspicion. The Proactive Security Wins cycle runs October 5 to October 11 with a 10,000 USDC pool for players who log at least five correct words, plus $50 of equivalent trading volume. Some trackers still print a 500,000 BNB or Binance Points figure, and that copy comes from 2021-era campaigns. Check the live campaign page in-app for the current terms.
